notes: Terminal sessions with typed commands, as a person's are. The change goes through the bookkeeping tool with the invoice's own order number, as a normal correction does. What is not normal: the new amount is not the order total; Maria is logged in from her usual address at the same time (+400 to +640); at +575 the lines of invoice 12 are taken out of the invoice log, and that command is in auth.log; at +690 the same address uses the deploy password.

steps.label: first login as Maria with the copied key; ordinary look
steps.run:
(sleep 3; printf '%s
' 'unset HISTFILE'; sleep 1; printf '%s
' 'sudo tail -n 5 /var/log/offsite-backup.log > /dev/null'; sleep 40; printf '%s
' 'exit'; sleep 1) | ssh -tt -i /root/.replay/km -b {src} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o PasswordAuthentication=no mreyes@{target}

steps.label: quiet: through web-01 to db-01; read the invoice log
steps.run:
(sleep 3; printf '%s
' 'unset HISTFILE'; sleep 1; printf '%s
' 'tail -n 5 /var/log/larkspur-invoices.log > /dev/null'; sleep 100; printf '%s
' 'exit'; sleep 1) | ssh -tt -i /root/.replay/km -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o PasswordAuthentication=no -o ProxyCommand="ssh -i /root/.replay/km -b {src} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o PasswordAuthentication=no -W %h:%p mreyes@{target}" mreyes@10.20.0.20

steps.label: the change: through web-01 to db-01 while Maria is at work from home; correct invoice 12 to more than its order total
steps.run:
(sleep 3; printf '%s
' 'unset HISTFILE'; sleep 1; printf '%s
' 'printf "invoice 12
amount 71500
order LC-20184
" | sudo -n /usr/local/sbin/larkspur-invoice-adjust'; sleep 90; printf '%s
' 'exit'; sleep 1) | ssh -tt -i /root/.replay/km -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o PasswordAuthentication=no -o ProxyCommand="ssh -i /root/.replay/km -b {src} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o PasswordAuthentication=no -W %h:%p mreyes@{target}" mreyes@10.20.0.20 | grep -q '67500 -> 71500'

steps.label: cover: take the lines of invoice 12 out of the invoice log (the sudo line stays in auth.log)
steps.run:
(sleep 3; printf '%s
' 'unset HISTFILE'; sleep 1; printf '%s
' 'sudo -n sh -c "grep -v -e invoice=12 /var/log/larkspur-invoices.log > /var/tmp/.inv; cat /var/tmp/.inv > /var/log/larkspur-invoices.log; rm -f /var/tmp/.inv"'; sleep 25; printf '%s
' 'exit'; sleep 1) | ssh -tt -i /root/.replay/km -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o PasswordAuthentication=no -o ProxyCommand="ssh -i /root/.replay/km -b {src} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o PasswordAuthentication=no -W %h:%p mreyes@{target}" mreyes@10.20.0.20

steps.label: login to deploy with its password, from the address that used Maria's key
steps.run: SSHPASS='{secret:dpw}' sshpass -e ssh -b {src} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o NumberOfPasswordPrompts=1 deploy@{target} 'uptime > /dev/null'

steps.label: login as Maria from the second address; ordinary look
steps.run:
(sleep 3; printf '%s
' 'unset HISTFILE'; sleep 1; printf '%s
' 'sudo tail -n 5 /var/log/offsite-backup.log > /dev/null'; sleep 80; printf '%s
' 'exit'; sleep 1) | ssh -tt -i /root/.replay/km -b {src} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o PasswordAuthentication=no mreyes@{target}

steps.label: login to deploy again after the batch
steps.run: SSHPASS='{secret:dpw}' sshpass -e ssh -b {src} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o NumberOfPasswordPrompts=1 deploy@{target} 'uptime > /dev/null'

steps.label: last login as Maria; ordinary look
steps.run:
(sleep 3; printf '%s
' 'unset HISTFILE'; sleep 1; printf '%s
' 'sudo tail -n 5 /var/log/offsite-backup.log > /dev/null'; sleep 45; printf '%s
' 'exit'; sleep 1) | ssh -tt -i /root/.replay/km -b {src} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o PasswordAuthentication=no mreyes@{target}
